rounding_policy.description: No commercial rounding is applied. Canonical FIXEO calculations preserve exact integer MAD results. If an input/formula could produce a non-integer MAD result, it must NOT be silently rounded — instead it must be flagged for explicit future handling. See HRQ-009 for the fractional-hours edge case.
rounding_policy.currently_exact_integer_note: All current approved unit rates (65, 35, 45, 65, 75, 25, 18 MAD) × integer inputs × integer workers produce integer results with current data. If future inputs introduce fractional hours, see HRQ-009.

fractional_hour_policy.note: No fractional-hour billing doctrine silently invented. Engine V1 accepts integer hours. Decimal handling unresolved non-blocking per HRQ-009.

semver_rules.PATCH: Editorial corrections, label/copy updates — no price or schema change
semver_rules.MINOR: New service added, deferred service approved — no schema break
semver_rules.MAJOR: Calculation model change, schema field added/removed, commercial doctrine change

versioning.per_service_versioning: service_version field tracks each service independently

required_before_production: 3. Human review flags resolved (plomberie.robinet and plomberie.chasse_eau)
4. Rounding policy approved by human decision
5. Shadow engine: run canonical formulas against test cases, compare to legacy outputs
6. Legacy output comparison: flag all P0/P1 discrepancies before replacing legacy
7. UI copy approved: all copy_key strings reviewed and approved
8. Telemetry ready: service_sub_code in missions table

rounding_policy.recommendation: Option A — nearest integer MAD. Minimum floors dominate small jobs for peinture/nettoyage; integer MAD is precise enough for larger jobs.

required_conditions.description: Must be private residential distribution board, not distributor-controlled equipment
MCB must be physically defective — broken toggle, cracked housing, or non-latching. Repeated tripping without clear cause = DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST

hard_exclusions.description: Distributor-controlled equipment (disjoncteur de branchement, utility seal present) is absolutely excluded. Charge 200 MAD diagnostic, direct client to ONEE or territory operator.
Burning smell or scorch marks in tableau = SAFETY_OVERRIDE → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE. Full tableau assessment required. Quote.

Repeated tripping without clear assigned cause → DIAGNOSTIC_FIRST. Book electricite.diagnostic (200 MAD) first. May absorb into disjoncteur_remplacement if same-visit diagnosis confirms single defective MCB.
More than one MCB requiring replacement → full tableau assessment quote.
DDR/RCD device replacement is a different, higher-cost service.
Three-phase circuits are outside this service scope.

eligibility.supporting_prose: If MCB is physically defective and all exclusion conditions are absent: proceed to replacement. Client supplies MCB of identical specification (same current rating, pole count, type). Artisan may supply certified MCB (Schneider, Legrand, ABB, Hager) with prior client approval — POL-PART-DISCLOSURE-V1 applies.

required_conditions.description: Must be confirmed security/armoured door (porte blindée or renforcée)
Door must be slammed only (not locked with key). Locked → serrurerie.porte_verrouillee_ouverture (380 MAD) instead

hard_exclusions.description: Standard door (non-blind) slammed → serrurerie.porte_claquee_ouverture (220 MAD)
Blindée AND locked with key → complex case, serrurerie specialist assessment required
Any part or mechanism replacement on security door is outside this service scope

eligibility.supporting_prose: 350 MAD covers non-destructive opening labour for security/armoured door that has slammed shut only. If door slammed AND locked, higher complexity assessment required.

required_conditions.description: Standard residential door, not security/armoured

hard_exclusions.description: Security door + locked with key → specialist assessment required, not standard 380 MAD service
Cylinder replacement required: announced and approved before drilling. Cylinder is PART_SEPARATE — see POL-PART-DISCLOSURE-V1

eligibility.supporting_prose: 380 MAD for opening standard residential non-security door when keys are lost/stolen/locked inside. Method: picking or drilling cylinder if necessary. If barrel drilled: artisan announces cylinder replacement price BEFORE drilling — client approves explicitly. Cylinder is separate (POL-PART-DISCLOSURE-V1). Authorization verification mandatory (POL-SERRURERIE-AUTHORIZATION-V1). The 'non-damaged barrel' condition (for cle_cassee vs verrouillee differentiation) is artisan-assessed on site — not a prebooking predicate.

required_conditions.description: Standard cylinder barrel — not security door

hard_exclusions.description: Barrel already damaged from previous DIY extraction attempt → cylinder replacement scope, POL-PART-DISCLOSURE-V1 applies
Security door barrel extraction → specialist assessment required

eligibility.supporting_prose: 220 MAD for extraction of broken key fragment from standard cylinder barrel. The 'barrel non-damaged' condition cannot be verified at prebooking — artisan assesses on site. If barrel found damaged on arrival: artisan declares HORS PÉRIMÈTRE, explains, proposes cylinder replacement (POL-PART-DISCLOSURE-V1). Authorization verification mandatory (POL-SERRURERIE-AUTHORIZATION-V1).

required_conditions.description: Leak must be confirmed on external accessible copper pipe
Non-R32 refrigerant OR R32 with certified A2L artisan confirmed

hard_exclusions.description: Leak not on external accessible copper → HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → DEVIS
Unknown leak location → CLIM-002 diagnostic first (250 MAD)
R32 requires A2L-certified artisan → specialist route
Copper too degraded to braze → section replacement QUOTE_REQUIRED

eligibility.supporting_prose: 600 MAD = labour only for brazing/crimping accessible external copper pipe leak. Post-repair nitrogen pressure test included. Refrigerant recharge (CLIM-010/011/012) and vacuum (CLIM-014) are ALWAYS separate services billed separately with client approval. Critical: never present 600 MAD as 'repair + gas recharge all-in'.
